# Tasks: Dude Development Base Release

Apply the approved Development Base Release About design bound in `spec.md`. The two units are sequential: first produce and carry provenance, then consume it in About. The task descriptions and dependencies below are definition proposals; execution and closure remain coordinator-owned.

## Shared Boundaries

The Scope lists include all intended repository writers, including Tester edits and generated deliverables. Declare those exact paths before each Work authorization. Rebuild generated output through the existing scripts, not by hand. If another path must change, return to the existing scope owner before writing; preserve unrelated dirty work.

Keep the approved 075 mock, its 23 captures, all 074 artifacts and approvals, the manifest's existing schema, Compose profile, earlier upgrade-log history, Settings navigation/styles/theme, and Review implementation unchanged. The only new runtime metadata path is `.dude/metadata/development-base-release.md`; generate it through the planned producer, never by hand. Upgrade tests may mutate only their disposable fixtures. No live upgrade, dependency installation, or commit, merge, or push of this repository is part of these units.

Use existing test fixtures and harness-owned OS temporary evidence paths. For browser/host checks, use Node 22+ with global WebSocket, a verified installed Edge executable in `DUDE_CANVAS_BROWSER`, and verified `DUDE_COPILOT_SDK`, `DUDE_COPILOT_CLI`, and `DUDE_COPILOT_RUNTIME` values. The Windows CLI must be `copilot.exe`, not a `.cmd` or `.bat` shim. Every required check must execute; report failures and skips rather than weakening an assertion, substituting a host, or treating zero selected cases as coverage. Each unit receives ordinary testing and independent review.

## Phase 1: Foundational Provenance

- [x] T001@d8c3a59e [US2] Record development base provenance in source builds and confirmed core upgrades.
    Scope:
        - Authoritative source writers: `src/skills/dude-engine/lib/workspace-paths.mjs`, `src/skills/dude-engine/lib/development-base-release.mjs`, `scripts/build-dev.mjs`, and `src/skills/dude-bundle-upgrade/upgrade.mjs`.
        - Test writers: `scripts/build-dev.test.mjs`, `scripts/build-release.test.mjs`, and `src/skills/dude-bundle-upgrade/upgrade.test.mjs`. Extend their existing fixtures; add no separate harness.
        - Procedure writer: `src/skills/dude-bundle-upgrade/SKILL.md`, limited to the optional record, schema-v2 plan contract, reviewed metadata transitions, ownership boundary, and existing explicit bootstrap behavior.
        - Projected writers: `.github/skills/dude-engine/lib/workspace-paths.mjs`, `.github/skills/dude-engine/lib/development-base-release.mjs`, `.github/skills/dude-bundle-upgrade/upgrade.mjs`, and `.github/skills/dude-bundle-upgrade/SKILL.md`, generated only by `node scripts/build-dev.mjs`.
        - Generated metadata writer: `.dude/metadata/development-base-release.md`, created, updated, or removed only by the development builder. No About, frontend, manifest, profile, live upgrade-log, or UI asset writer belongs to this unit.
    Trace: US2; FR-001–004, FR-011–012; SC-002, SC-003, SC-005's build/upgrade boundary; plan "Chosen Structure", "Optional Record", "Source Development Build", "Confirmed Main Refresh", and "Delivery Sequence" unit 1.
    Acceptance:
        1. Add the one fixed metadata path and pure record parser/renderer. Enforce the plan's single UTF-8 JSON payload with exactly nonblank `source_repo` and stable `base_release`; reject invalid types, extra fields/payloads, malformed text, and non-stable values without coercion. Unknown provenance has no record; add no timestamp, revision, registry, or integrity claim.
        2. The development build preflights its fixed output before cleanup, uses only the exact source Git root and highest stable tag merged into its current commit, and reuses existing numeric release ordering. Missing Git, wrong root, shallow history, no reachable tag, or failed evidence acquisition yields an absent record rather than a remote lookup, parent-project lookup, or guessed version. Reconcile a known, changed, unknown, or non-development result after projection; avoid identical-byte rewrites and preserve all other metadata.
        3. A target `main` upgrade consumes only valid provenance from its already-selected upstream tree, associated with that tree's development manifest. Bind the local record to the outgoing manifest's exact selected source. Cover local-source overrides, absent/malformed/wrong-source records, and switches to release/other refs. Never inspect consumer-project versions or add a release lookup, fetch, or hidden second upgrade.
        4. Freeze upstream/local expected record states and the desired record or absence in the existing plan digest and evidence checks. Use the closed schema-v2 envelope; require old plans to be recreated. Show metadata-only changes in the normal preview and no-op calculation. Confirmation, source/cache/local drift, unsafe paths/types, and TTL failures retain their existing refusal before writes. Apply uses reviewed values without reclassification or a fresh lookup.
        5. Include record writes/removals in the existing applied-path, commit, and committed-core boundary checks. A completed upgrade's rollback restores the prior known record or absence. A true no-op writes nothing; clearing obsolete provenance is not suppressed by `--skip-removals`. Preserve existing failure reporting, safety-tag/branch, pack-refresh, and rollback policy without adding a recovery layer.
        6. Keep the manifest readers/writers and allowed keys unchanged. Release fixtures still emit `source_ref: latest` and the requested installed tag, with no development record in the release metadata. Existing installs without the new record remain valid; the updated engine can preview and apply the subsequent metadata-only refresh with fresh confirmation. Keep existing manifest rejection tests intact.
        7. Extend the named build/upgrade suites for these cases, including excluded unmerged/prerelease tags, invalid optional records, zero-write refusal/no-op, and rollback. Update the owning procedure text and preserve source/generated parity. This prerequisite is accepted on its recording/upgrade boundary; no About UI or installed-host acceptance is required yet.
    Check:
        - `node scripts/build-dev.mjs`
        - `node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/build-dev.test.mjs scripts/build-release.test.mjs src/skills/dude-bundle-upgrade/upgrade.test.mjs`
        - `node .github/skills/dude-lint/lint.mjs .`

Missing, malformed, unreadable, wrong-source, unsafe, or invalid-UTF-8 optional data nulls only the supplement. Preserve existing whole-manifest and independently unusable-ref behavior.
        2. Update the frontend's closed response validator with the adapter. Render the approved suffix only for a known development base; a null base stays exactly `Development (main)`. Release, other-ref, and channel classifications remain unchanged. Preserve the ordinary note for valid responses, including null refs, and the existing unavailable note for transport/shape failures. All values remain inert text; disclose no source location, raw document, path, credentials, or error detail.
        3. Retain the existing route, trust/root/lifetime/no-store guards, loading and cancellation behavior, author, repository anchor, Packs state, selected-versus-query state, unsent work, and Review continuity. About itself runs no process, Git command, external acquisition, or state write, and reads at most the two fixed local files. Do not add controls, polling, warnings, retries, or an integrity claim.
        4. Extend the existing server and browser fixtures for all six approved states and optional-record failures. Compare fresh rendered output with the bound 075 mock at the plan's light/dark sizes and 200% reflow, including the narrow scrollbar-gutter case. Prove word wrapping, no horizontal overflow or inaccessible clipping, visible focus, keyboard scrolling to the channel row, accessibility-tree semantics, note selection, contrast, and loading/error transitions. Keep the approved artifact and all reference pins unchanged.
        5. Reuse T011's production provider for the changed About read and retained Packs/work/Review round trips. Extend T012's pre-seeded owned fixtures to keep the regular release case and include a known development base through the extension launched by the actual installed `copilot.exe`. Verify the served response, displayed values, and return without losing work. Do not substitute a Node-hosted receiver, add a new harness, or let the loopback model make post-seed canonical writes.
        6. Rebuild Canvas before projecting core. Keep app/legal and static Review source/generated parity and the existing size contract. Refresh only affected runtime pins, including `scripts/build-dev.test.mjs`, and bind any new 075 design comparison to the approved CRLF-normalized hash. Update only the relevant usage text. No old mock capture, prior host observation, skip, or wrapper pass substitutes for fresh execution of the named checks.
